args.title: AC-1: Reset app state from the menu empties the cart and the cart badge is not shown
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user|The product list ("Products") is displayed
2. Add the first product to the cart|The cart badge shows "1"
3. Open the navigation menu|The menu opens
4. Click "Reset App State"|The menu action completes
5. Observe the cart badge|The cart badge is not shown

args.title: AC-2: Logout from the menu shows the sign-in page
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user|The product list ("Products") is displayed
2. Open the navigation menu|The menu opens
3. Click "Logout"|The Logout action completes; the sign-in page ("Swag Labs") is displayed
4. (Security extension) Navigate directly to /inventory.html|The sign-in page is shown — the session is invalidated and the product list is not accessible

args.title: AC-3: After logout, going back in the browser does not show the product list
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user|The product list ("Products") is displayed
2. Open the navigation menu|The menu opens
3. Click "Logout"|The sign-in page ("Swag Labs") is displayed
4. Click the browser Back button|The sign-in page is still shown — the product list is not displayed
